dashboard.label: MITRE ATT&CK Coverage Matrix
dashboard.description: Live comparison of production/risk-accepted correlation searches against the full ATT&CK technique set from ctm_mitre_lookup.csv. Cell text is "Technique (detection count)". Bucket 0 = zero detections for that technique.

panel.title: Coverage by tactic - quick scan before the full matrix

search.query: | rest /servicesNS/-/-/saved/searches | search disabled=0 | fields title action.correlationsearch.annotations | rex field=action.correlationsearch.annotations "\"(?i)status\":\s*\[\"(?<status>[^\"]+)\"\]" | rex field=action.correlationsearch.annotations max_match=0 "\"(?<mitre_attack_id>T[0-9]{4}(?:\.[0-9]{3})?)\"" | mvexpand mitre_attack_id | search status IN (tg_prod, risk_only) mitre_attack_id=T* | stats count AS detection_count BY mitre_attack_id | append [| inputlookup ctm_mitre_lookup.csv | fields ID tactic | rename ID as mitre_attack_id | eval detection_count=0] | stats sum(detection_count) as detection_count, values(tactic) as tactic by mitre_attack_id | mvexpand tactic | stats count as techniques_total, sum(eval(if(detection_count=0,1,0))) as techniques_uncovered, sum(eval(if(detection_count>=1 AND detection_count<=2,1,0))) as techniques_thin by tactic | eval coverage_pct=round((techniques_total-techniques_uncovered)/techniques_total*100,1) | table tactic techniques_total techniques_uncovered techniques_thin coverage_pct | sort coverage_pct

panel.title: ATT&CK Coverage Matrix - production and risk-accepted detections

search.query: | rest /servicesNS/-/-/saved/searches | search disabled=0 | fields title action.correlationsearch.annotations action.notable.param.security_domain search | rex field=action.correlationsearch.annotations "\"(?i)status\":\s*\[\"(?<status>[^\"]+)\"\]" | rex field=action.correlationsearch.annotations max_match=0 "\"(?<mitre_attack_id>T[0-9]{4}(?:\.[0-9]{3})?)\"" | mvexpand mitre_attack_id | search status IN (tg_prod, risk_only) mitre_attack_id=T* | stats count AS detection_count BY mitre_attack_id | append [| inputlookup ctm_mitre_lookup.csv | fields ID name tactic | rename ID as mitre_attack_id, name as technique_name | eval detection_count=0] | stats sum(detection_count) as detection_count values(technique_name) as technique_name values(tactic) as tactic by mitre_attack_id | mvexpand tactic | mvexpand technique_name | sort 0 tactic technique_name | streamstats count as row_id by tactic | eval range_bucket=case( detection_count==0, 0, detection_count<=2, 1, detection_count<=4, 2, detection_count<=6, 3, detection_count<=10, 4, detection_count>10, 5 ) | eval cell_display = technique_name . " (" . detection_count . ")" | eval cell_value = cell_display . ":" . range_bucket | xyseries row_id tactic cell_value | sort 0 row_id | table row_id "Reconnaissance" "Resource Development" "Initial Access" "Execution" "Persistence" "Privilege Escalation" "Defense Evasion" "Credential Access" "Discovery" "Lateral Movement" "Collection" "Command and Control" "Exfiltration" "Impact" | fields - row_id
